mapper.update: UPDATE sq_response_execution SET status = 'FAILED', version = version + 1, completion_proposal_json = NULL, proposal_hash = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND scope_id = #{scopeId} AND status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'PARTIAL', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED') AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL

UPDATE sq_goal_task SET status = 'RECOVERY_BLOCKED', version = version + 1, blocked_reason = '执行资料或技能授权已变化', completion_proposal_json = NULL, proposal_hash = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND scope_id = #{scopeId} AND status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'PARTIAL', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'RECOVERY_BLOCKED') AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL

UPDATE sq_worker_job SET status = 'RECOVERY_BLOCKED', guard_token = NULL, guard_lease_until = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('READY', 'RUNNING', 'BLOCKED', 'WAITING_INPUT', 'WAITING_APPROVAL')

UPDATE sq_command SET status = 'BLOCKED', delivery_token = NULL, delivery_lease_until = NULL, last_error_code = 'EXECUTION_CONTEXT_INVALIDATED' WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND scope_id = #{scopeId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'DELIVERING') AND action <> 'STOP'
